name: @ferry/mobile
description: Native iOS and Android shells for the Ferry dashboard (Capacitor).

scripts.build:web: VITE_API_URL=${FERRY_API_URL:?set FERRY_API_URL to your hosted Ferry API} npm run build --workspace apps/web --prefix ../..
scripts.ios: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios 2>/dev/null; npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android 2>/dev/null; npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
